findings.summary: The new tick step has no test. retire-failed-landed.test.ts exercises retireFailedLanded directly, but nothing runs runDispatchTick with completedOnMain set. Nothing checks that the step runs on the tick, or that a throw inside it is swallowed. AC-1 and AC-3 say 'on the next tick', and the hierarchy.ts wiring is also untested.
findings.title: pipeline-cli/src/hierarchy/dispatch-loop.ts: the new tick step has no test. retire-failed-landed.test.ts exercises retirefailedlanded directly, but nothing runs rundispatchtick with completedonmain se

findings.summary: completedTaskIdsOnMain runs two spawnSync('git') calls on every tick that finds a failed verdict, and neither has a timeout. A hung git process would block the tick synchronously.
findings.title: pipeline-cli/src/dispatch/retire-landed.ts: completedtaskidsonmain runs two spawnsync('git') calls on every tick that finds a failed verdict, and neither has a timeout. a hung git process would block

findings.summary: mkdirSync(retiredDir) runs before the verdict is parsed, so a corrupt verdict leaves an empty retired/ directory. Moving the mkdir after the parse is cleaner.
findings.title: pipeline-cli/src/dispatch/retire-landed.ts: mkdirsync(retireddir) runs before the verdict is parsed, so a corrupt verdict leaves an empty retired/ directory. moving the mkdir after the parse is cleane

findings.summary: A merged task PR on record retires the failed verdict even if the failure is newer than the landing. The spec allows this; noted only.
